get.summary: Get combined user progress and OFT history.
get.description: Returns entries from both sources from the last seven days plus direct-mint bridge entries in AWAITING_RECOVERY or RECOVERY_PENDING regardless of age, newest first. Direct-mint history requires xrpAddress. The supplied addresses select history records; this endpoint does not prove ownership of either wallet.

parameters.name: xrpAddress
parameters.description: Checksum-valid XRP classic address used to select direct-mint history and direct-mint bridge candidates.

400.description: xrpAddress is not a valid XRP classic address.

get.summary: Get remaining OFT transfer capacity in drops, keyed by destination endpoint ID.
get.description: Cached snapshot refreshed once per minute. Returns an empty object until the first successful refresh and keeps the last complete snapshot if a refresh fails. Unlimited capacity is represented by the maximum uint256 value.

get.summary: Get OFT redemption and direct-mint bridge history.

Direct-mint bridge history requires xrpAddress. The supplied addresses select history records; this endpoint does not prove ownership of either wallet.

directMinting.description: Whether this is a direct minting (no agent)

evm_txhash.description: EVM transaction hash of the event that resolved this direct minting (null until executed)

remainingAmount.description: Remaining amount in UBA (for incomplete redemptions)

delayTimestamp.description: Timestamp (seconds) when a delayed direct minting can be executed

tagId.description: Destination tag ID on XRP ledger

mintingRecipient.description: EVM address that receives minted FAssets

allowedExecutor.description: Allowed executor address for this tag

executorChangePending.description: Whether an allowed executor change is currently pending for this tag

pendingNewExecutor.description: The new executor address that will become active after the pending change completes

executorChangeActiveAfterTs.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the pending executor change becomes active

recipient.description: EVM address that receives minted FAssets for this tag

fassetsExecutorFee.description: Executor fee in FAsset UBA (drops) for direct minting

reservationFee.description: Tag reservation fee in native wei

redemptionFee.description: Combined configured system and regular redemption fee in BIPS, rounded to the nearest BIP

remainingAmountUBA.description: Remaining amount in UBA for amount-based incomplete redemptions

feePercentage.description: Combined configured system and regular redemption fee percentage

feeUSD.description: Estimated combined redemption fee in USD for one lot

delayed.description: Whether this direct minting is delayed

delayTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when a delayed direct minting can be executed

amountSentLD.description: Exact source amount sent, in local decimals.

amountReceivedLD.description: Exact quoted destination amount, in local decimals.

eid.description: LayerZero endpoint ID; direct mints use the saved Smart Accounts destination EID until OFTSent is indexed, or null if unavailable.

destinationKind.description: Saved Smart Accounts bridge destination kind for direct mints; null if unavailable.

txhash.description: Transaction hash. DIRECT_MINT_BRIDGE uses the uppercase, unprefixed XRPL hash.

guid.description: LayerZero message GUID for RECEIVE, REDEEM, and REDEEMFAIL entries.

toHypercore.description: Whether the OFT destination is HyperCore; null before a direct-mint OFTSent match.

status.description: Whether source processing is complete; this is not a success or LayerZero delivery indicator.

remainingAmountUBA.description: Remaining amount in UBA for amount-based incomplete redemptions

amountEstimated.description: Whether the displayed direct-mint amount is estimated rather than sourced from OFTSent.

directMinting.description: Whether this entry represents a direct mint.

directMintingStatus.description: Source direct-mint lifecycle status. RECOVERY_PENDING means a matching XRP recovery payment was observed; the original action is not complete yet.

delayTimestamp.description: Direct-mint release timestamp in Unix seconds.

xrplTxHash.description: Uppercase, unprefixed XRPL transaction hash for a direct mint.

evmTxHash.description: Flare transaction hash of the local resolving execution event.

oftSent.description: Matched source OFTSent event; null before execution or while the OFT reader is behind.

incomingRemainingDrops.description: Remaining incoming rate-limit capacity from this endpoint ID, in drops.

outgoingRemainingDrops.description: Remaining outgoing rate-limit capacity to this endpoint ID, in drops.

exact.description: Exact balance in base units (wei, drops, etc.)

type.description: Category of the token: wnat, fasset, or collateral
